name: First Complex
source:
She relocated schools due to a situation with her parents. Since then she rarely visited home. It's unknown if she had friends or not. She was invested only in a cute cat named Hayate.

Her bangs were always getting in her face. She was modest and plain. It was the only way she could be comfortable. She'd built a fortress around herself.

But on the first day of her relocation, not knowing the school policy, she shrugged off warnings about her hair. The one who warned her was the super-snobby class president...!?

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE095816.html]DLsite english[/url]]
translation:
因为父母的原因她转了学。从那以后她很少回家。不知道她有没有朋友。她唯一在意的是一只叫疾风的可爱猫咪。

刘海总是遮住她的脸。她朴素而平凡。这是她唯一感到自在的方式。她在自己周围筑起了一座堡垒。

但转学的第一天，不了解校规的她无视了关于头发的警告。警告她的人是那个超级高傲的班长……！？
